evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of chest pressure with exertion.

Findings: Sinus bradycardia at 58 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 162 ms, QRS 80 ms, QTc 412
ms.
Impression: Sinus bradycardia, otherwise normal tracing.
Most recent echo showed an ejectiion fraction of 35%.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
60%. Trace mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 135 mmol/L
Potassium: 3.6 mmol/L
Chlorie: 105 mmol/L
CO2: 25 mmol/L
BUN: 26 mg/dL (H)
Creatinine: 0.7 mg/dL
Glucose: 103 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 9.0 mg/dL

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Atorvastatin 20 mg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: alert, no acute distress.
Neck: supplle, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, grade 2/6 systolic ejection
murmur, no radiation.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.
